a.name: Question bars
a.description: Each block a full-width band holding one narrow column of filled question bars with chevrons; the middle band takes the bone bed.
a.differs_from: Filled bars in a narrow centred column on a band, no photo; London's pick is a photo rail beside a numbered ledger, and the built rows are plain accordions or a card with a jump list.

b.name: Rows beside a photo
b.description: Display-face rows between hairlines beside one portrait per block (Christa, Maggie, a Manchester pup), the photo swapping sides.
b.differs_from: Each block pairs its rows with its own portrait, side alternating, on the open page under a rule; London's pick runs one photo rail beside a ledger on a band.

c.name: Lead beside rows
c.description: Each block under a steel rule, its question full width; the open lead answer on a bone sheet beside one column of folded rows.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, layout: London's open lead above a two-column fold grid becomes the lead in its own column beside one column of rows. Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
